epoch: J1991.25 propagated to J2000 by proper motion; the ten stars without a solution keep their J1991.25 sexagesimal position
attribution: Credit: ESA; ESA, 1997, The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200

positionFromSexagesimal.note: J1991.25, no proper motion, not propagated

filter: Vmag <= 7.5, Hipparcos stars with a position, finder chart depth
normalisations: Sorted by Vmag rounded to 0.1 (Math.round(Vmag * 10)), then HIP number
HIP numbers order the stars but are not stored: the file holds no HIP, only the order the HIP tie-break gives

pos: one comma-joined string of integers, one per star, raCenti * 18001 + (decCenti + 9000), with raCenti the J2000 right ascension in 0.01 degrees (0..35999, 36000 wrapped to 0) and decCenti the declination in 0.01 degrees (-9000..9000); positions as in the bright file
mag: runs of [tenths, count] over the sorted stars, tenths being the magnitude as an integer in 0.1

designations: sparse, keyed by star index; each a tuple [bayer, flamsteed, con, proper] with null for an absent field (bayer: Greek abbreviation with a -n component suffix; flamsteed: integer), kept only for stars that have a Bayer letter, Flamsteed number or IAU name; constellation: IAU abbreviation from astronomy-engine Constellation() at the star's J2000 position
No other Hipparcos field is read
